notes: HF26.20.26 LEVEL-RANGE DUNGEON BIS TEST built ON TOP OF HF26.20.25, retaining HF26.20.23 Weapon Sets UI styling, HF26.20.24 Blizzard Character button reposition, and HF26.20.25 Offline Whisper Guard. Dungeon Advisor now defaults to cross-dungeon per-character best currently equippable AtlasLoot boss drops from COMPLETED accessible dungeon scans. Shows item, slot, source dungeon and boss and Pawn score/NEW, only the strongest per ordinary slot; for two physical ring/trinket slots a second candidate is explicitly CHECK PAIR (not certified as jointly best). Uses each Druid's native Pawn scale for raw same-slot ranks; locked complete 2H/1H/off-hand set values for weapons, never standalone onehand raw. Level requirements, incomplete/stale/unknown scans, and absent members conservatively handled; coverage and confidence shown. BOSS DETAILS preserves original per-dungeon Need view. Gear/lock changes mark old data STALE and require manual rescan. No global WoW BiS claim; quest, profession, world drops are outside this AtlasLoot dungeon scan. No automatic gear equipping or background updates. Only LootPlanner.lua, version metadata and new README differ from HF26.20.25; all 32 Lua parse, candidate tests, ZIP CRC, SHA-256 and 132 protected files byte checks PASS. Ingame acceptance OPEN. Manual HaploBox UPDATE only.
